tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The test constructs fresh mutable linter, walker, and checker state, registers callbacks, and walks a parsed module (tests/utils/unittest_ast_walker.py:18-58). ASTWalker initialization creates callback maps; add_checker scans dir(checker), filters visit/leave methods by enabled messages, and optionally registers defaults (pylint/utils/ast_walker.py:28-69). Repeating this incurs setup work, but the source does not establish significant degradation or a bottleneck across thousands of tests; that requires measurement.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The fixture defines Coords in MyObject’s class body before def my_method(self) -> Coords, inside nested_class_as_return_annotation (tests/functional/u/used/used_before_assignment_type_annotations.py:77-90). The return annotation uses the enclosing definition context, where the prior class binding is available; the method body’s local scope is not the starting point. Pylint has a special return-annotation case that checks the enclosing class locals and whether the definition precedes the method (pylint/checkers/variables.py:2303-2316). This fixture checks avoidance of a false used-before-assignment diagnostic, not a general contract for importing modules or all type checkers.

DocStringStyleChecker tests the raw docstring’s first character and emits docstring-first-line-empty when it is newline (pylint/extensions/docstyle.py:51-61). tasks.corrected_reference_answer: A possible refactor is to accept an iterable and predicate in a helper that stops at the first true predicate result, then yield the alternative only when the helper reports exhaustion. Preserve laziness, short-circuiting, empty-iterable behavior and exception propagation. The original fixture is at tests/functional/u/use/use_yield_from.py:42-47. Independent tests can cover the predicate itself, early-stop consumption, and alternative emission on exhaustion. This is a proposed design, not implemented in the repository. The use-yield-from checker does not document this testing rationale; its guards include comparison of loop target and yielded name (pylint/checkers/refactoring/refactoring_checker.py:1164-1186).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The premise is not established. StatementRole simply inherits SQLRole (tests/regrtest_data/max_inferable_limit_for_classes/nodes/roles.py:73-74). The regression fixture uses it among many bases of ColumnElement, then derives FunctionElement and months_between; the file identifies a SQLAlchemy-inspired inference issue (tests/regrtest_data/max_inferable_limit_for_classes/main.py:1-38). This can exercise static class inference, but it contains no large database-query batch benchmark and does not demonstrate repeated uncached runtime MRO computation or quantify performance.
